title: Home health
do: Spot the cardiology group whose referrals dropped and draft a check-in before the quarter closes.

title: Hospice
do: Follow up with the oncology practice after each admission and close the loop with the referring nurse.

title: Skilled nursing and rehab
do: Rank discharge planners by admissions and plan your liaison's hospital rounds.

title: Private-pay home care
do: Thank the care manager who sent two clients this month, and flag the rehab that stopped calling.

title: Outpatient physical therapy
do: Show which orthopedic practices send post-op patients, track them month over month, and thank the surgeon's office after each new start.

title: Home infusion
src: Hospital discharge planners and case managers
do: Show which hospitals and specialists send IV antibiotic, TPN and specialty infusion starts, track them month over month, and follow up with the ID group whose referrals slipped.

title: Palliative care
do: Show which specialists refer early enough to matter, and who to reach next.

title: Home medical equipment
do: Rank the case managers and pulmonology clinics that send orders, and follow up on every order that stalls.

title: Wound care
do: Show which podiatrists and home health agencies refer, and close the loop with them at each healing milestone.

title: Dialysis and kidney care
do: Track which nephrology practices refer new starts and catch a drop before it shows up in your census.

title: Assisted living
do: Track which placement agents send move-ins, not just tours, and keep them warm.

title: Memory care
do: Nudge the neurology office that hasn't sent a family in two months.

title: Adult day and respite
do: Show which community partners send enrollments and plan visits around them.

title: Behavioral health
do: Score every therapist and psychiatrist who refers, and draft the thank-you after each intake.

title: Addiction treatment
do: Check in with the interventionist who has gone quiet and follow up on every open admission.

title: Eating disorder treatment
do: Keep each outpatient team in the loop and follow up when a referral stalls.

title: ABA and autism therapy
do: Follow up with the developmental pediatrician after each diagnosis referral and keep families moving from waitlist to intake.

title: Pediatric and private duty nursing
do: Organize outreach to NICU case managers and follow up on every pending referral.
